title: Danube River — Commercial Navigation Locks
description: All commercial-shipping locks on the Danube from Kelheim (Germany, head of large-vessel navigation) to Sulina (Black Sea), sorted upstream → downstream by Donaukilometer (RKM). Hungarian, lower-Romanian/Bulgarian, and Ukrainian reaches are free-flowing — no commercial-navigation locks. River-km uses the international Donaukilometer convention: km 0 at Sulina, increasing upstream.
river_km_convention: Donaukilometer (DonauNAV): km 0 at Sulina mouth, increasing upstream toward source (~km 2857 at Donaueschingen)
